answer: The design leans on invitation quota tree, taxed when attestations come from one subnet, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Each submission hangs on the comet of a task receipt, and the canyon is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the quartz of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
